description: Commitfest entries whose latest cfbot build fails on at least one platform: cf_id, title, entry_status and commitfest_number. entry_status filters (default the active reviewable statuses, e.g. needs-review, ready-for-committer); platform narrows to one CI platform; limit caps the list. Cite https://commitfest.postgresql.org/patch/<cf_id>/.

entry_status.description: Restrict to entries in this status (e.g. needs-review, ready-for-committer). Default: any active status.

platform.description: Restrict to entries failing on this platform keyword (e.g. linux, macos, windows, freebsd, netbsd, openbsd).

name: find_failing_patches
